blocks.en: Quality Assurance, Documentation and Special CSPs

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明使用商業製造產品（單次劑量、多次劑量、批量包裝）作為原料成分的時限規定
blocks.en: Explain the time limits for using commercially manufactured products (single-dose, multiple-dose and bulk packages) as components

blocks.zh: 描述 SOP 的建立、審查和修訂要求，以及人員必須接受哪些訓練
blocks.en: Describe the requirements for establishing, reviewing and revising SOPs, and what training personnel must receive

blocks.zh: 區分 QA 和 QC 的定義與職責，並了解品質計畫的必要元素
blocks.en: Distinguish the definitions and responsibilities of QA and QC, and understand the required elements of a quality program

blocks.zh: 說明召回程序、投訴處理和不良事件通報的 SOP 要求
blocks.en: Explain the SOP requirements for recalls, complaint handling and adverse event reporting

blocks.zh: 解釋過敏原萃取物調配的特殊豁免規定（Section 21）及其前提條件
blocks.en: Explain the special exemption for compounding allergenic extracts (Section 21) and its prerequisites

blocks.zh: 15–16. Use of Conventionally Manufactured Products & CSPs as Components | 商業產品與CSP作為原料
blocks.en: 15–16. Use of Conventionally Manufactured Products & CSPs as Components

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：開封後使用期限的邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Logic of Use Time After Opening

blocks.zh: 商業製造產品開封後的使用期限是基於：容器被穿刺或打開後，無菌屏障即被破壞，微生物污染風險從這一刻開始。
blocks.en: The use time for a commercially manufactured product after opening is based on this: once the container is punctured or opened, the sterile barrier is breached and the risk of microbial contamination begins from that moment.

blocks.zh: 單次劑量瓶（在 ISO 5 下穿刺）：12 小時
blocks.en: Single-dose vial (punctured in ISO 5): 12 hours

blocks.zh: 安瓿（已開）：不得儲存任何時間 → 立即使用
blocks.en: Ampule (opened): may not be stored for any length of time → use immediately

blocks.zh: 多次劑量瓶（含防腐劑）：28 天（或廠商標示）
blocks.en: Multiple-dose vial (with preservative): 28 days (or as labeled by the manufacturer)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：安瓿開封後的「零儲存」規定
blocks.en: Key Point: The "Zero Storage" Rule for Opened Ampules

blocks.zh: 開封的單次劑量安瓿（glass ampule）必須立即使用，不得儲存任何時間。這比玻璃瓶（vial）嚴格得多——原因是安瓿開封後形成完全開放的開口，無任何再密封機制，微生物和微粒污染風險極高。
blocks.en: An opened single-dose glass ampule must be used immediately and may not be stored for any length of time. This is far stricter than for a vial, because an opened ampule leaves a completely open neck with no means of resealing, so the risk of microbial and particulate contamination is very high.

blocks.zh: 若調配需要安瓿的內容物，必須在無菌條件下立即使用，剩餘部分立即丟棄。
blocks.en: If a compounding operation requires the contents of an ampule, they must be used immediately under aseptic conditions, and any remainder discarded immediately.

blocks.zh: 開封後使用期限快速對照
blocks.en: Quick Reference: Use Time After Opening

blocks.zh:
商業產品：
  單次劑量瓶（ISO 5 穿刺） → 最多 12 小時
  安瓿（開封後）           → 零儲存，立即使用
  多次劑量瓶               → 最多 28 天（或廠商標示）
  藥房批量包裝             → 依廠商標示

CSP 組件：
  多次劑量 CSP（已開）     → BUD 或 28 天（較短者）
  單次劑量/儲備液（ISO 5） → BUD 或 12 小時（較短者）
blocks.en:
Commercial products:
  Single-dose vial (punctured in ISO 5)  → up to 12 hours
  Ampule (after opening)                 → zero storage, use immediately
  Multiple-dose vial                     → up to 28 days (or as labeled by the manufacturer)
  Pharmacy bulk package                  → per manufacturer's labeling

CSP components:
  Multiple-dose CSP (opened)             → BUD or 28 days (whichever is shorter)
  Single-dose/stock solution (ISO 5)     → BUD or 12 hours (whichever is shorter)

blocks.zh: 比喻：SOP 如同作業標準說明書
blocks.en: Analogy: An SOP Is Like a Standard Operating Manual

blocks.zh: 想像一家連鎖餐廳：每個分店的廚師都遵循同一套詳細的烹飪 SOP——食材用量、料理順序、安全溫度、衛生要求。即使每天的廚師不同，出餐品質仍然一致。
blocks.en: Imagine a restaurant chain: the cooks at every branch follow the same detailed cooking SOP covering ingredient quantities, order of preparation, safe temperatures and hygiene requirements. Even though the cook is different each day, the quality of the food served stays the same.

blocks.zh: 調配設施的 SOP 作用相同：確保不同人員在不同班次中，都能以一致且合規的方式調配 CSP。
blocks.en: SOPs in a compounding facility serve the same purpose: they ensure that different personnel, on different shifts, compound CSPs in a consistent and compliant way.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 藥師在 ISO Class 5 LAFW 中打開一支 20 mL 的單次劑量注射用生理食鹽水小瓶，用了 10 mL。剩餘的 10 mL 可以保留多久？
blocks.en: A pharmacist opens a 20 mL single-dose vial of sterile saline for injection in an ISO Class 5 LAFW and uses 10 mL. How long can the remaining 10 mL be kept?

blocks.zh: 一批 Category 2 CSP 使用了一個 CSP 儲備液（stock solution）作為原料，該儲備液的 BUD 是 7 天。最終 CSP 的 BUD 可以超過 7 天嗎？
blocks.en: A batch of Category 2 CSPs used a CSP stock solution as a component, and the stock solution has a BUD of 7 days. Can the BUD of the final CSP exceed 7 days?

blocks.zh: SOP 修訂後，指定人員是否需要通知所有相關人員？人員是否需要確認接受了修訂通知？
blocks.en: After an SOP is revised, must the designated person notify all relevant personnel? Must personnel confirm that they have received the revision notice?

blocks.zh: 18. Quality Assurance and Quality Control | 品質保證與品質管制
blocks.en: 18. Quality Assurance and Quality Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QA vs QC — 系統 vs 測試
blocks.en: Core Concept: QA vs QC — System vs Testing

blocks.zh: QA (Quality Assurance, 品質保證)：預防性的系統性活動，確保整個調配過程符合標準。QA 是「確保不會出錯的體制」。
blocks.en: QA (Quality Assurance): Preventive, systematic activities that ensure the entire compounding process meets standards. QA is "the system that ensures errors do not happen".

blocks.zh: QC (Quality Control, 品質管制)：透過採樣、測試和記錄，在放行前確認規格已達到。QC 是「確認這批次沒有出錯的驗證」。
blocks.en: QC (Quality Control): Confirms through sampling, testing and recording that specifications have been met before release. QC is "the verification that this batch has no errors".

blocks.zh: 類比：QA 是餐廳的食安體系（培訓、清潔規範、驗收標準）；QC 是每道菜出餐前的試嚐確認。
blocks.en: Analogy: QA is a restaurant's food safety system (training, cleaning rules, acceptance criteria); QC is the taste check on each dish before it goes out.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：召回 SOP 的設計必須包含患者追蹤機制
blocks.en: Key Point: A Recall SOP Must Include a Patient Tracing Mechanism

blocks.zh: 召回 SOP 中最關鍵但常被忽略的要素：必須能識別哪些患者已經接受了該 CSP。這需要完整的配發記錄追蹤系統。
blocks.en: The most critical but often overlooked element in a recall SOP: it must be able to identify which patients have already received the CSP. This requires a complete dispensing record tracking system.

blocks.zh: 若記錄不完整，一旦發生召回，無法通知受影響患者，將面臨重大監管和法律責任。這是調配設施需要強健的電子記錄系統的核心原因之一。
blocks.en: If records are incomplete, then in the event of a recall the affected patients cannot be notified, which creates major regulatory and legal liability. This is one of the core reasons compounding facilities need a robust electronic records system.

blocks.zh: 比喻：CSP 召回如同汽車召回
blocks.en: Analogy: A CSP Recall Is Like a Car Recall

blocks.zh: 汽車製造商召回問題車型的流程：(1) 確認問題嚴重性、(2) 識別所有受影響車輛和車主、(3) 通知車主、(4) 提供補救措施、(5) 記錄和向監管機構報告。
blocks.en: The process by which an automaker recalls a faulty model: (1) confirm the seriousness of the problem, (2) identify all affected vehicles and owners, (3) notify the owners, (4) provide a remedy, (5) document it and report to the regulator.

blocks.zh: CSP 召回程序完全相同邏輯，只是「車主」換成「患者」，「車輛 VIN」換成「CSP 批號/處方編號」。
blocks.en: A CSP recall procedure follows exactly the same logic, except that the "owner" becomes the "patient" and the "vehicle VIN" becomes the "CSP lot number/prescription number".

blocks.zh: QA/QC 年度審查要求
blocks.en: Annual QA/QC Review Requirements

blocks.zh:
QA/QC 程序年度審查要求：
  頻率：至少每 12 個月一次
  執行者：Designated Person(s)
  結果：必須記錄
  必要時：採取適當行動

SOP 年度審查要求：
  頻率：至少每 12 個月一次
  更改時：記錄、通知相關人員
  人員應確認收到通知

投訴記錄必須包含：
  • 投訴者姓名或唯一識別碼
  • 接到投訴日期
  • 投訴性質
  • 回應措施
  • 調查結果和後續
blocks.en:
Annual review of QA/QC procedures:
  Frequency: at least once every 12 months
  Performed by: Designated Person(s)
  Results: must be documented
  When necessary: take appropriate action

Annual review of SOPs:
  Frequency: at least once every 12 months
  When changed: document it and notify relevant personnel
  Personnel should confirm receipt of the notification

A complaint record must include:
  • Name or unique identifier of the complainant
  • Date the complaint was received
  • Nature of the complaint
  • Response taken
  • Investigation results and follow-up

blocks.zh: 實務應用：溫度偏差的決策流程
blocks.en: Practical Application: Decision Process for a Temperature Excursion

blocks.zh: 當發現 CSP 儲存溫度偏差時，designated person 必須根據以下步驟決策：
blocks.en: When a storage temperature excursion for a CSP is found, the designated person must make a decision according to the following steps:

blocks.zh: 確認偏差幅度和持續時間
blocks.en: Confirm the magnitude and duration of the excursion

blocks.zh: 查閱藥物穩定性文獻或廠商資料
blocks.en: Consult the drug stability literature or manufacturer data

blocks.zh: 若能確認 CSP 仍符合品質要求 → 記錄後放行或繼續使用
blocks.en: If it can be confirmed that the CSP still meets quality requirements → document it, then release or continue to use it

blocks.zh: 若無法確認 → 必須丟棄，不得猶豫
blocks.en: If it cannot be confirmed → it must be discarded, without hesitation

blocks.zh: 每次偏差都必須記錄，即使決定繼續使用。
blocks.en: Every excursion must be documented, even if the decision is to continue using the CSP.

blocks.zh: 一家調配設施的滅菌測試結果（在 CSP 已配發後）顯示某批次失敗。必須立即採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: A compounding facility's sterility test results (after the CSPs have already been dispensed) show that a batch has failed. What steps must be taken immediately?

blocks.zh: 患者打電話投訴 CSP 顏色異常。投訴記錄中必須包含哪些最低資訊？
blocks.en: A patient calls to complain that a CSP has an abnormal color. What minimum information must the complaint record contain?

blocks.zh: 若 QA 年度審查發現某個 SOP 已過時，誰可以授權修改？修改後必須做什麼？
blocks.en: If the annual QA review finds that an SOP is out of date, who can authorize the change? What must be done after the change?

blocks.zh: 20–21. Documentation & Compounding Allergenic Extracts | 文件管理與過敏原萃取物調配
blocks.en: 20–21. Documentation & Compounding Allergenic Extracts

blocks.zh: 核心概念：文件保存的「2年規則」
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "2-Year Rule" for Document Retention

blocks.zh: 所有 CSP 相關文件必須保存至少 2 年，但若法規或認可機構要求更長，則以更長者為準。
blocks.en: All CSP-related documents must be retained for at least 2 years, but if regulations or an accrediting body require longer, the longer period applies.

blocks.zh: 這意味著設施必須建立系統性的文件管理：無論是紙本或電子，都必須易於查閱（readily retrievable）。在稽查時，能否在幾分鐘內調出2年前的特定批次記錄，是衡量文件管理成熟度的重要指標。
blocks.en: This means the facility must set up a systematic document management system: whether paper or electronic, records must be readily retrievable. During an inspection, whether a specific batch record from 2 years ago can be pulled within minutes is an important indicator of the maturity of document management.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：過敏原萃取物的特殊豁免
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Special Exemption for Allergenic Extracts

blocks.zh: Section 21 是 ⟨797⟩ 中少數具有顯著豁免的特殊案例。過敏原萃取物調配不需要符合一般 Category 1/2/3 的所有要求，但有嚴格的前提條件：
blocks.en: Section 21 is one of the few special cases in ⟨797⟩ with a significant exemption. Compounding of allergenic extracts does not need to meet all the general Category 1/2/3 requirements, but strict prerequisites apply:

blocks.zh: 必須使用已許可的商業無菌過敏原產品
blocks.en: Licensed commercial sterile allergenic products must be used

blocks.zh: 只涉及無菌針頭/注射器穿刺和液體轉移
blocks.en: Only sterile needle/syringe puncture and liquid transfer are involved

blocks.zh: 不涉及化學合成或非無菌原料
blocks.en: No chemical synthesis or non-sterile ingredients are involved

blocks.zh: 重點提示：AECA — 過敏原調配的替代空間
blocks.en: Key Point: AECA — An Alternative Space for Allergen Compounding

blocks.zh: AECA（Allergenic Extract Compounding Area）是專為過敏原調配設計的非分類空間，類似 SCA 的概念但更寬鬆。AECA 不需要達到任何 ISO 等級，但必須有可見的周界（visible perimeter），且調配期間禁止其他活動進行。
blocks.en: The AECA (Allergenic Extract Compounding Area) is an unclassified area designed specifically for allergen compounding. It is similar in concept to an SCA but less stringent. An AECA does not need to meet any ISO class, but it must have a visible perimeter, and no other activities may take place during compounding.

blocks.zh: 這項豁免的存在反映了現實：大多數過敏科診所無法在短期內建造無菌調配室，但仍需在合規框架內為患者調配個人化的免疫治療注射液。
blocks.en: The existence of this exemption reflects reality: most allergy clinics cannot build a sterile compounding room in the short term, yet still need to prepare individualized immunotherapy injections for patients within a compliant framework.

blocks.zh: 比喻：文件是品質系統的「記憶」
blocks.en: Analogy: Documentation Is the "Memory" of the Quality System

blocks.zh: 如果品質系統沒有文件，就像一家沒有記帳的企業——你不知道昨天賺了多少，更無法向稅務機關證明。
blocks.en: A quality system without documentation is like a business with no bookkeeping: you do not know how much you earned yesterday, and you certainly cannot prove it to the tax authority.

blocks.zh: CSP 的文件管理也是如此：若沒有完整記錄，一旦患者出現不良反應，無法追溯是哪一批次的 CSP 出了問題，也無法證明設施按照 ⟨797⟩ 規定操作。
blocks.en: The same holds for CSP document management: without complete records, if a patient has an adverse reaction, it is impossible to trace which batch of CSPs had the problem, or to prove that the facility operated in accordance with ⟨797⟩.

blocks.zh: 文件保存期限要求
blocks.en: Document Retention Requirements

blocks.zh:
最低要求：製備後 2 年
例外：若法規或認可機構要求更長 → 以更長者為準

常見情況：
  ACHC/PCAB 認可機構可能要求更長保存期
  某些州法規也可能要求 3 年以上

過敏原萃取物 BUD 計算：
  最長 = 混合/稀釋日期起算 1 年
  或所有成分的最短效期（哪個早）
blocks.en:
Minimum requirement: 2 years after preparation
Exception: if regulations or an accrediting body require longer → the longer period applies

Common situations:
  ACHC/PCAB accrediting bodies may require a longer retention period
  Some state regulations may also require 3 years or more

Allergenic extract BUD calculation:
  Maximum = 1 year from the date of mixing/dilution
  or the shortest expiration date of any component (whichever is earlier)

blocks.zh: 實務應用：電子記錄系統的合規要求
blocks.en: Practical Application: Compliance Requirements for Electronic Record Systems

blocks.zh: 電子記錄和電子簽名可以滿足 ⟨797⟩ 的文件要求，前提是：(1) 可隨時調取；(2) 有適當的備份機制；(3) 有審計追蹤（audit trail）防止擅自修改。
blocks.en: Electronic records and electronic signatures can satisfy the documentation requirements of ⟨797⟩, provided that: (1) they can be retrieved at any time; (2) there is an appropriate backup mechanism; and (3) there is an audit trail to prevent unauthorized changes.

blocks.zh: 電子系統的稽查缺失通常集中在：無備份、可輕易修改記錄（沒有 audit trail）、或舊記錄在系統更新後無法讀取。
blocks.en: Audit findings for electronic systems typically concentrate on: no backup, records that can be easily altered (no audit trail), or old records that cannot be read after a system update.

blocks.zh: 某設施 3 年前為一名患者調配了 Category 2 CSP，現在有投訴。設施是否仍需保留相關文件？
blocks.en: A facility compounded a Category 2 CSP for a patient 3 years ago and has now received a complaint. Must the facility still retain the relevant documents?

blocks.zh: 過敏科診所在診間調配個人化過敏原注射液，不使用 ISO Class 5 PEC，而是在 AECA 中調配。這是否符合 ⟨797⟩？前提條件是什麼？
blocks.en: An allergy clinic compounds individualized allergen injections in the exam room, not using an ISO Class 5 PEC but compounding in an AECA. Is this compliant with ⟨797⟩? What are the prerequisites?

blocks.zh: 過敏原萃取物處方集的 BUD 最長可達多久？是否有任何能延長 BUD 的條件？
blocks.en: What is the maximum BUD for an allergenic extract prescription set? Are there any conditions that can extend the BUD?

blocks.zh: Glossary — Selected Key Terms | 詞彙表精選
blocks.en: Glossary — Selected Key Terms

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text — Key Definitions
blocks.en: Original Text — Key Definitions

blocks.zh: 核心概念：詞彙表的合規意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Compliance Significance of the Glossary

blocks.zh: USP ⟨797⟩ 的詞彙表不只是定義清單，而是具有法律效力的標準用語。使用精確的術語有三個實務重要性：
blocks.en: The glossary of USP ⟨797⟩ is not just a list of definitions but standard terminology with legal force. Using precise terms matters in practice for three reasons:

blocks.zh: 稽查溝通：稽查員和業者對同一術語有相同理解，避免誤解
blocks.en: Inspection communication: inspectors and operators share the same understanding of a term, avoiding misunderstandings

blocks.zh: SOP 撰寫：使用官方術語確保 SOP 符合監管語言
blocks.en: SOP writing: using official terms ensures SOPs conform to regulatory language

blocks.zh: 爭議解決：當法規解釋有爭議時，詞彙表提供基準定義
blocks.en: Dispute resolution: when the interpretation of a requirement is disputed, the glossary provides the baseline definition

blocks.zh: 重點提示：三個容易混淆的術語對比
blocks.en: Key Point: Comparing Three Easily Confused Terms

blocks.zh: CAI ≠ Pharmaceutical Isolator（本章明確聲明兩者不同）
blocks.en: CAI ≠ Pharmaceutical Isolator (the chapter explicitly states that the two are different)

blocks.zh: CAI：無自動去污系統，手動進出
blocks.en: CAI: no automated decontamination system, manual transfer in and out

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical Isolator：必須有自動去污系統（如 VHP）和 RTP，需要 ISO Class 8 室
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Isolator: must have an automated decontamination system (such as VHP) and an RTP, and requires an ISO Class 8 room

blocks.zh: PEC 是整個設備（如整個 LAFW 工作台）
blocks.en: The PEC is the entire piece of equipment (such as the whole LAFW workbench)

blocks.zh: DCA 是 PEC 內部最關鍵的直接調配區域，暴露於「第一道氣流 (first air)」
blocks.en: The DCA is the most critical direct compounding area inside the PEC, exposed to "first air"

blocks.zh: 比喻：First Air — 最乾淨的空氣
blocks.en: Analogy: First Air — The Cleanest Air

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器就像淨水器的濾芯：直接從濾芯流出的水（first air）是最純凈的，尚未接觸任何其他表面。調配人員必須確保 CSP 的關鍵部位（critical sites）只暴露在 first air 中，而不是接觸過設備表面的「二手空氣」。
blocks.en: A HEPA filter is like the cartridge in a water purifier: the water coming directly out of the cartridge (first air) is the purest, having not yet touched any other surface. Compounding personnel must ensure that the critical sites of a CSP are exposed only to first air, not to "second-hand air" that has passed over equipment surfaces.

blocks.zh: 這就是「不要用身體阻擋 first air 流向 critical site」規則的根本依據。
blocks.en: This is the fundamental basis for the rule "do not block first air from the critical site with your body".

blocks.zh: 實務應用：動態 vs 靜態操作條件的稽查意義
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Audit Significance of Dynamic vs Static Operating Conditions

blocks.zh: 「Dynamic operating conditions」要求在人員存在、模擬最複雜操作的條件下進行測試。這意味著：
blocks.en: "Dynamic operating conditions" require testing to be performed with personnel present and simulating the most complex operations. This means:

blocks.zh: 認證測試必須在代表最壞情況的條件下進行
blocks.en: Certification testing must be performed under conditions representing the worst case

blocks.zh: 環境監測採樣必須在動態條件下進行
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring sampling must be performed under dynamic conditions

blocks.zh: 若設施在「沒人、沒操作」時進行測試，結果會被認為不具代表性
blocks.en: If a facility tests when "no one is present and no operations are taking place", the results will be considered unrepresentative

blocks.zh: 本章綜合複習 Comprehensive Review
blocks.en: Comprehensive Review

blocks.zh: 一位新藥師加入調配設施，聲稱他已在上一家設施完成過 Category 2 的 media-fill 測試（6個月前）。這個結果是否可以轉移使用？為什麼？
blocks.en: A new pharmacist joins a compounding facility and claims to have completed a Category 2 media-fill test at the previous facility (6 months ago). Can this result be transferred? Why?

blocks.zh: 設施想用一台 Pharmaceutical Isolator 調配 Category 3 CSP。需要建造前室嗎？需要 ISO Class 7 緩衝室嗎？
blocks.en: A facility wants to use a Pharmaceutical Isolator to compound Category 3 CSPs. Is an ante-room needed? Is an ISO Class 7 buffer room needed?

blocks.zh: 一批 Category 2 CSP 從非無菌原料調配，以無菌充填方式，未進行滅菌測試，冷藏儲存。最長 BUD 為何？若加入滅菌測試且通過呢？
blocks.en: A batch of Category 2 CSPs is compounded from non-sterile components by aseptic filling, without sterility testing, and stored refrigerated. What is the maximum BUD? What if sterility testing is added and passed?

blocks.zh: 設施在 ISO Class 7 緩衝室的表面採樣（月度）結果為 7 cfu/media device（動作水準 >5）。必須立即停止調配活動嗎？接下來的步驟是什麼？
blocks.en: The facility's monthly surface sampling in the ISO Class 7 buffer room gives a result of 7 cfu/media device (action level >5). Must compounding activities be stopped immediately? What are the next steps?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 商業容器開封後使用期：單次劑量瓶（ISO 5）≤12h；安瓿零儲存；多次劑量瓶 ≤28天
blocks.en: Use time of commercial containers after opening: single-dose vial (ISO 5) ≤12h; ampule zero storage; multiple-dose vial ≤28 days

blocks.zh: QA vs QC：QA 是確保過程的系統；QC 是確認結果的測試。兩者均需書面 SOP 並每年審查。
blocks.en: QA vs QC: QA is the system that assures the process; QC is the testing that confirms the result. Both require written SOPs and annual review.

blocks.zh: 召回 SOP：必須包含患者識別程序、分發追蹤、向監管機構報告
blocks.en: Recall SOP: must include a patient identification procedure, distribution tracking and reporting to the regulator

blocks.zh: 文件保存：最少 2 年（法規要求更長者從其規定）
blocks.en: Document retention: at least 2 years (where regulations require longer, follow those requirements)

blocks.zh: 過敏原萃取物：可使用 AECA（非分類空間）；BUD ≤1年（或最短成分效期）；GFT 每年一次
blocks.en: Allergenic extracts: an AECA (unclassified area) may be used; BUD ≤1 year (or the shortest component expiration date); GFT once a year
